info.title: OutReign API
info.summary: B2B lead intelligence and outbound sales API
info.description: REST API for OutReign leads, deals, activities, contacts and AI email generation. Authenticate with an X-API-Key header generated in OutReign → Settings → API Keys.

400.description: Invalid JSON body, or contact_name and company_name are required

post.description: Each lead is validated and inserted separately. Leads that fail are reported in errors by their index in the request.

400.description: Invalid JSON body, leads array is required, or Maximum 100 leads per request

patch.description: Send the full record. Fields you omit are cleared, and fields with a default are reset to it.

post.description: Consumes one enrichment credit from the authenticated account's plan. Send a JSON body; {} is enough. Some failures (free plan, no credits left) return 200 with error and error_code.

400.description: Invalid JSON body or Operation failed

403.description: Lead not found or unauthorized, or API access is not included in your plan

post.summary: Score a lead against the saved ICP
post.description: Send a JSON body; {} is enough.

403.description: Lead not found or unauthorized, or API access is not included in your plan

400.description: Invalid JSON body, or title and company_name are required

patch.description: Send the full record. Fields you omit are cleared, and fields with a default are reset to it.

400.description: Invalid JSON body, or subject and type are required

patch.description: Send the full record. Fields you omit are cleared, and fields with a default are reset to it.

post.description: Send at least one of first_name, last_name or email.

400.description: Invalid JSON body, or At least first_name, last_name, or email is required

patch.description: Only the fields you send are changed. Other fields, including id, are ignored.

400.description: Invalid JSON body, or No updatable fields provided

post.summary: Generate an AI email draft for a lead
post.description: Consumes AI email credits from the authenticated account's plan. Some failures return 200 with error and error_code instead of a draft.

lead.description: The lead to write to. id is required; other lead fields are used to personalize the draft.

senderEmail.description: Used to sign the draft when senderName is empty and your profile has no name. Defaults to your first connected sending account.

400.description: Invalid JSON body, or tone, goal or lead data is missing or invalid

403.description: Lead not found or unauthorized, or API access is not included in your plan

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Create keys in OutReign → Settings → API Keys.

OAuth2.description: Human-delegated OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, used by the OutReign MCP server.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired API key

Forbidden.description: API access is not included in your plan (Starter and above)

RateLimited.description: Rate limit or daily request limit reached

Lead.description: String fields longer than their maxLength are truncated, not rejected. country, pipeline_stage and icp_score are returned but ignored on create and update.

Deal.description: String fields longer than their maxLength are truncated, not rejected.

Activity.description: String fields longer than their maxLength are truncated, not rejected.

Contact.description: String fields longer than their maxLength are truncated, not rejected.

status.description: HTTP status, included on 404 responses for a record.

x-payment-info.description: Metered API usage is billed against an OutReign subscription; agent-native per-call payment is available via x402/MPP.
